description: I'm Marwan Sarhan, 15, from Egypt. I'm into STEM and coding. I took courses in Python, Arduino, Electronics, and Mechanics. I joined NASA Space Apps, AIO 2026, and a DivPost hackathon. I'm at New York Junior Academy. For me, skills aren't everything. I want a teammate who loves to work and engages with me, even if their skills aren't strong yet. A team should work together to reach the best result.
